title: rp-a -> rp-b (allow get) -> rp-a (no allow) calls get

unsafe.definition: any assertion to the inner rp-a.test frame that has rp-b.test as ancestor

note: Permissions Policy: the inner frame's container (in rp-b) does not delegate, and the default 'self' is checked against the parent rp-b -> disabled; L3 §5.1.4.1 -> NotAllowedError despite the top being rp-a.
